title: LLaVA: Visual Instruction Tuning
description: LLaVA connects a CLIP vision encoder to Llama using a simple linear projection, then fine-tunes on GPT-4-generated visual instruction following data (image + text → instruction → response triples). Despite architectural simplicity, achieves 85.1% relative performance to GPT-4V on visual instruction following. Launched the open-source VLM research wave.
authors: Liu, Li, Wu, Lee (UW Madison / Microsoft Research)
